document.name: MakeInspires Upper East Side STEAM Birthday Parties
document.shortDescription: Official MakeInspires Upper East Side STEAM birthday parties bring hands-on maker activities to ages 5-14 in a private York Avenue makerspace.
document.longDescription:
MakeInspires publishes dedicated STEAM birthday parties at its Upper East Side makerspace in Manhattan. The official party page says children and their guests can explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math through hands-on themes tailored to the birthday child's interests, with the venue offering exclusive use of a 3,000-square-foot makerspace.

The official page lists pricing starting at $1,200 for 10 children, plus $50 per additional child. Included food is two slices of pizza per child, spring water, paper goods, and utensils, while optional add-ons include balloon decor, a photo booth, a professional photographer, extra party time, a dance party extension, face painting, and custom goodie bags.

Published party availability is Fridays from 6:30 p.m. to 8:15 p.m., Saturdays at 1:30 p.m. and 4:15 p.m., and Sundays at 10:45 a.m., 1:30 p.m., and 4:15 p.m. The same source says these parties are best for ages 5-14 and are hosted at MakeInspires Upper East Side, 1642 York Ave, New York, NY 10028. Contact details listed on the page are nyc@makeinspires.com and 212-933-4392.

Sources: https://www.makeinspires.com/parties-ues https://static.wixstatic.com/media/107b16_90e0c564101f42f7be19baedcd6e1b3d~mv2.jpeg/v1/fit/w_2169,h_1392,q_90,enc_avif,quality_auto/107b16_90e0c564101f42f7be19baedcd6e1b3d~mv2.jpeg
